name: clicks
sql:
CREATE TABLE clicks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,            -- ISO 8601 UTC
  slug TEXT NOT NULL,          -- product id, as in offers.json
  click_id TEXT NOT NULL,      -- random id passed to the network as <slug>.<click_id> (CJ sid / Awin clickref)
  network TEXT,                -- cj | awin
  method TEXT,                 -- GET or HEAD (link checkers)
  referrer TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  verified_bot TEXT,           -- Cloudflare verified-bot category, if any
  bot_like INTEGER DEFAULT 0   -- crude user-agent heuristic
, kind TEXT DEFAULT 'redirect', query TEXT, utm_source TEXT, asn INTEGER, ch_ua TEXT)

name: landings
sql:
CREATE TABLE landings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,            -- ISO 8601 UTC
  page TEXT NOT NULL,          -- path without slashes or .html ("" = home); equals clicks.slug on a product page
  path TEXT NOT NULL,          -- raw request path
  method TEXT,                 -- GET or HEAD
  status INTEGER,              -- status the origin answered with (200, 301, 404)
  query TEXT,                  -- raw query string
  utm_source TEXT,             -- parsed utm_source, e.g. chatgpt.com
  referrer TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  verified_bot TEXT,           -- Cloudflare verified-bot category, if any
  bot_like INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- same user-agent heuristic as clicks
  purpose TEXT                 -- Sec-Purpose / Purpose header: set on browser prefetches and prerenders
, asn INTEGER)

name: agent_pages
sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_pages (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,            
  agent TEXT NOT NULL,         
  path TEXT NOT NULL,          
  status INTEGER,
  user_agent TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  asn INTEGER,                 
  as_org TEXT,                 
  verified_bot TEXT,
  signature_agent TEXT,        
  signature_input TEXT         
)

name: pageviews
sql:
CREATE TABLE pageviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,            -- ISO 8601 UTC
  page TEXT NOT NULL,          -- path without slashes or .html ("" = home), as landings.page
  status INTEGER,
  platform TEXT,               -- chatgpt | perplexity | gemini | claude | copilot | meta | google | bing | direct | internal | other ...
  tag TEXT,                    -- raw utm_source or ref: tag, if any
  referrer TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT,
  country TEXT,
  asn INTEGER,
  bot_like INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  backfill INTEGER DEFAULT 0
, ch_ua TEXT, ch_platform TEXT)
